intro.h2: Showers and tile that make the whole bathroom
paragraphs: Queen City Renovation focuses on bathroom remodeling in Mint Hill, NC and around Charlotte. A typical project in our photos starts with a tired primary bath: a fiberglass shower shell and beige floor tile. We take it out and rebuild the room with marble, porcelain and custom niches.

Tile is the word that comes up most in our Google reviews, seven times so far. Homeowners also notice how we work. We prep the house before the job starts, clean up at the end of each day, stay on budget and give straight advice when you ask for it, which is why some clients hire us again.

items.name: Primary bathroom remodels
items.blurb: Full renovations of master and primary bathrooms: new shower, tub area, vanity, lighting and floor in one project. Recent jobs swapped garden tubs for freestanding soaking tubs set under the window, next to large walk-in showers with frameless glass.

image.alt: Freestanding white tub beside a walk-in tile shower with matte black rain head and mosaic floor

items.name: Tile and marble showers
items.blurb: This is where our crew does its best work. One family moved from a fiberglass shell to a marble shower with a marble accent wall. We build in recessed niches, sometimes lined with herringbone tile, plus benches and pebble or mosaic shower floors.

image.alt: Marble tile shower with two recessed niches lined in herringbone tile and dual shower heads

items.name: Vanities and cabinets
items.blurb: New double vanities with quartz-style tops, undermount sinks, framed mirrors and wall lights. Our recent bathrooms pair warm wood-tone shaker cabinets with white counters and brushed brass fixtures. Cabinets are one of the topics reviewers bring up on Google.

image.alt: Light wood double vanity with white top, two framed mirrors and brass wall lights

items.name: Flooring
items.blurb: New bathroom floors go in as part of the remodel, from large-format gray porcelain to light tile that runs from the vanity to the shower curb. A recent client called our crew master craftsmen in tile, flooring, electrical and wood.

image.alt: Large-format gray porcelain bathroom floor running from vanity to freestanding tub

items.name: Fireplaces and backsplashes
items.blurb: Our tile skills are not limited to bathrooms. We refaced a living room fireplace in stacked stone for one bathroom client and installed a kitchen backsplash for another before coming back to redo their primary bathroom.

image.alt: Living room fireplace refaced floor to ceiling in gray stacked stone with dark hearth

items.title: Tile done right
items.text: Tile is mentioned in 7 of our Google reviews. Clients describe the crew as talented, meticulous and master craftsmen, and the marble showers in our photos show why.

items.title: Your home treated with respect
items.text: We prep everything before work begins and clean up when the day is done. Reviewers also call the crew polite, professional and flexible when surprises come up.

items.title: Fair prices, budgets kept
items.text: Reviewers say the work was reasonably priced, that the price was fair, and that we stayed on budget from start to finish of a primary bathroom renovation.

items.title: A crew you get to know
items.text: Max leads the jobs with team members Slavic and Ivan. You see the same faces every day, and some clients have already hired us for a second project.

about.text: Queen City Renovation LLC is a bathroom remodeling company based on Connell Road in Mint Hill, working across the Charlotte area. Max leads the work with his crew, including Slavic and Ivan, and replies to reviews himself, often thanking both partners by name. Clients have trusted the team with first-time remodels and with repeat projects, starting with a backsplash and returning for the primary bathroom. They talk about clear communication, solid advice when asked, and patience when a project hit challenges that were nobody's fault.
about.owner_role: Leads the crew (named in Google reviews; signs owner replies as 'me and my crew')

steps.title: Walkthrough and advice

steps.text: You get a price for the work and a plan for the job. Reviewers say we stay on budget once the work starts.

steps.title: Prep, build, clean up

steps.title: Final walkthrough

items.name: Tuesday W.
items.text: Max and his team members, Slavic and Ivan, were exceptional at what they do.  They updated our shower from fiberglass shell to marble, added a marble accent wall and  replaced our flooring in our master bathroom.  They were talented, hardworking, and so polite and professional.  We faced some challenges during the project, no fault of their own, and they were understanding and flexible.  They also refaced our living room fireplace.  My husband and I had never taken on an endeavor like this before so we were glad to have such an experienced and meticulous team to work with.  I cannot say enough good things about Max and Queen City Renovations LLC.

items.name: Lauren S.
items.text: We completed our primary bathroom renovation in February, 2026; our second project working with Queen City Renovation. We are thrilled with the results. Key points about Queen City Renovation: 1) They are MASTER craftsmen be it tile, flooring, electrical, and wood, 2) They are respectful of your property. They prepped everything before the job began and cleaned up after the work day concluded, 3) They stayed on budget, and 4) They communicated well with me and gave me solid advice when I asked for it. I look forward to working with them on our next project and you will too.

items.name: Keely D.
items.text: We just finished a master bathroom renovation with Queen City Renovation and couldn’t be happier. Max and Ivan were amazing, the work was excellent and reasonably priced. We highly recommend Queen City Renovations!

service_area.h2: Bathroom remodeling in Mint Hill, NC and Charlotte
service_area.text: Our shop is at 10227 Connell Rd in Mint Hill, and our Instagram lists Charlotte, North Carolina as home base for the crew. Most of our bathrooms, showers and fireplace jobs are in and around those two places. If you live nearby and are not sure we cover your street, call or text (704) 989-3052 and we will let you know.

items.q: What kind of bathroom work do you do?
items.a: Full primary and master bathroom renovations: tearing out fiberglass shower shells, building tile and marble showers with niches and benches, setting freestanding tubs, installing new vanities and laying new floors. We have also refaced a fireplace and installed a backsplash for bathroom clients.

items.q: Where are you located and what areas do you serve?
items.a: We are at 10227 Connell Rd, Mint Hill, NC 28227, and we work around Charlotte, North Carolina. If you are unsure whether your home is in range, call or text (704) 989-3052 with your town and a short description of the project.

We are open Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 6 PM. We are closed on Saturday and Sunday. You can call or text (704) 989-3052 during the week or email Queencityrenovation@gmail.com at any time with photos of your bathroom.

items.q: Will you keep my house clean during the work?
items.a: Yes. A recent client wrote that we prepped everything before the job began and cleaned up after each work day. Other reviewers describe the crew as polite, professional and respectful, which matters when we are working inside your home for several days.

items.q: How do I get a price?
items.a: Call or text (704) 989-3052 or send photos to Queencityrenovation@gmail.com. Max will set up a time to see the bathroom and talk through what you want. Reviewers describe our pricing as fair and reasonable, and say we stayed on budget.

final_cta.text: Call or text Max and the crew to talk about your bathroom.
